notes.title: Added better gallery, achievements and a bugfix
notes.content:
Today I rolled the update mentioned a few days ago:

You should have:
[list]
[*]Scene gallery with animation, text, sound, music
[*]Achievements (you must replay the game again, sry)
[*]Fixed a bug mentioned by a player when you have to option to "Charge". If you "Play it cool" you skip the mechanic workshop altogether
[/list]

[b]The winter special DLC scene for Ep. 1 is still in planning. The girl with most votes will have a special scene featured as a FREE DLC for Ep. 1. Express your suggestion now.[/b]

notes.title: Upcoming updates
notes.content:
Like I did with Ep. 2...
I will add a gallery that allows full replay of a scene including dialogue, sounds and music.
Also some Steam achievements because why not. Expect this update to come in the next few days.

Even though I'll focus on Ep. 3 (final) for the moment it struck me the idea of releasing a [b]free DLC[/b] for this for winter holidays maybe. Like an extra scene or something.

It is a good option to[b] comment down below which of the characters of Ep. 1 you would like to be featured in a special scene[/b] (mini story + animation).
